title: Per-Invoice Attempt Count
description: Every invoice keeps its own tally of payment attempts — a second invoice's first try shouldn't inherit a number from someone else's ledger.
successCondition: Create two separate invoices for two different shipments, then make exactly one POST /api/billing/invoices/:id/pay call against each. Both responses show payment.attemptNumber equal to 1, even though two Payment rows now exist system-wide. Confirm via `npm run db:psql` that both payments rows have attempt_number = 1 and different invoice_id values.
hints: attemptNumber is computed per-invoice (count of existing payments for that invoiceId, plus one) inside apps/api/src/modules/billing/service.ts, not from a global sequence.
Book two separate shipments first so you have two distinct shipmentIds to invoice.
